cases.title: Lazy branch via typed control edges
cases.equation: h = x @ w; y = c ? h + x : h - x
cases.fx:
v = fixtures.tensors(); g = fx.Graph(); root = nn.Module()
x = g.placeholder("x"); w = g.placeholder("w")
c = g.placeholder("c")
t, f = cond_modules(g, root, add, sub)
h = g.call_function(mm, (x, w))
r = g.call_function(torch.ops.higher_order.cond,
                    (c, t, f, (h, x)))
y = g.call_function(operator.getitem, (r, 0))
g.output(y)
model = fx.GraphModule(root, g)
condition = torch.tensor(predicate, dtype=torch.bool)
result = model(v["x"], v["w"], condition)

FX cond_modules constructs BOTH branch GraphModules (h+x and h-x, with cloned outputs) with explicit h/x operands. predicate is True or False. Fresh graph per invocation; not torch.where.
